encoding: C-contiguous little-endian IEEE754 float32; parameters are 78 sorted canonical names with separate normalized and physical f32 arrays; label is one byte 0 or 1
comparison: original bytes plus unaligned first/max/mean-absolute/RMS differences in binary64; no trimming, resampling or level normalization
process_policy: Each runtime/batch/repeat is a new process; each case constructs a fresh Voice. No cached render may qualify a repeat.
passive_control: global-0 at batch 32 in each runtime/repeat: remove hooks and profile, construct a second Voice and compare unhooked audio bytes
failure_policy: Every requested cell retained; error, timeout (1800 s per process), OOM or unavailable runtime is NO_VERDICT, never PASS. Measured byte disagreement is FAIL. Cross-runtime drift is reported without an equality requirement.

release.platform: linux/amd64 (Docker Desktop emulation on Apple M5); native linux/amd64 CI is an additional sentinel host, not full-matrix qualified
